newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Beast beats man in Israel's highest court.
newsitem.headline: Beast beats man in Israel's highest court.

text.p: Crocodiles scaled the walls of Israeli justice on Sunday, emerging from the Supreme Court as winners in a case against their human captors.
The court banned crocodile wrestling at a reptile farm in northern Israel where the minute-long bouts between man and beast have been an attraction.
Judges, overturning a lower court decision allowing the wrestling, said it was immoral to cause the crocodile suffering for the sake of people's entertainment, a court official said.
"This is big victory. At last I feel something is changing in this country in the sphere of animal rights," said Etty Altman, a spokeswoman for the animal rights group that filed the appeal.
